children: CEO Saleel Awsare to discuss NDAA-compliant unmanned systems and Edge AI at five networking and investor events in September
IRVINE, Calif., Sept. 08, 2026

, a global provider of Edge AI and Industrial IoT solutions that power NDAA-compliant unmanned systems, critical infrastructure and resilient enterprise networks, today announced that its CEO Saleel Awsare will participate in the following upcoming investor conferences:

params.linkText: Piper Sandler Government & Defense Technology CEO Summit

children: Tuesday, September 8, Four Seasons Hotel, Washington, D.C.
Executive networking sessions with CEO Saleel Awsare
Gabelli’s “Defending Our Nation” Leadership Forum
Wednesday, September 9, The Paley Center for Media (Bennack Theater), New York
Panel discussions on space, unmanned systems, artificial intelligence and cyber beginning at 1:30 p.m. ET, with participation from CEO Saleel Awsare
Gabelli’s 32nd Annual Aerospace & Defense Symposium
Thursday, September 10, Convene, 530 Fifth Ave., New York
Unmanned Aerial Vehicle (UAV) panel at 12:00–12:45 p.m. ET with CEO Saleel Awsare; a live webcast of the symposium will be available to registered institutional investors
Lake Street’s 10th Annual Best Ideas Growth (BIG10) Conference
Thursday, September 10, The Metropolitan Club, New York
One-on-one meetings with CEO Saleel Awsare and CFO Brent Stringham
Needham's Defense Tech Investor Day
Thursday, September 17, Needham & Company offices at Carlson Towers, 701 Carlson Parkway, Minnetonka, Minnesota
Presentation at 8:45–9:25 a.m. CT with CEO Saleel Awsare, followed by Q&A
About Lantronix
Lantronix Inc.

is a global leader in Edge AI and Industrial IoT solutions that power NDAA-compliant unmanned systems, critical infrastructure and resilient enterprise networks. It delivers intelligent computing, secure connectivity and remote management for mission-critical applications enabling customers to optimize operations, enhance security and accelerate digital transformation. Its comprehensive portfolio of hardware, software and services powers applications ranging from mission-critical autonomous platforms and edge analytics for critical infrastructure to intelligent surveillance and secure network management. By bringing intelligence to the network edge, Lantronix helps organizations achieve efficiency, security and a competitive edge in today’s AI-driven world. For more information, visit the Lantronix website.
